source_id: UC-GYM-001 Main Flow (BW-GYM-03, Club Not Created → Club Open)
purpose: Verify a Student Admin can create a club with required data and valid assignments.
preconditions: A Student Admin is authenticated. The coordinator and co-coordinator are valid students, the Club Faculty Councillor is valid faculty, and the category is Technical.
action_or_input: Submit a new club with all required data and the specified valid assignments.
expected_result: The club is created in the Club Open state.

source_id: UC-GYM-001 Main Flow; Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — required club data
purpose: Verify club creation requires the required data.
preconditions: A Student Admin is authenticated. All assignments and the category are valid.
action_or_input: Submit a new club with a required data item omitted.
expected_result: The club is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — coordinator assignments must refer to valid students
purpose: Verify an invalid coordinator assignment prevents club creation.
preconditions: A Student Admin is authenticated. All required data, other assignments, and the category are valid; the proposed coordinator is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit the new club.
expected_result: The club is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — co-coordinator assignments must refer to valid students
purpose: Verify an invalid co-coordinator assignment prevents club creation.
preconditions: A Student Admin is authenticated. All required data, other assignments, and the category are valid; the proposed co-coordinator is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Submit the new club.
expected_result: The club is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — Club Faculty Councillor must be a valid faculty member
purpose: Verify an invalid faculty assignment prevents club creation.
preconditions: A Student Admin is authenticated. All required data, other assignments, and the category are valid; the proposed Club Faculty Councillor is not valid faculty.
action_or_input: Submit the new club.
expected_result: The club is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — club category is restricted to Technical, Sports, or Cultural
purpose: Verify a category outside the allowed set prevents club creation.
preconditions: A Student Admin is authenticated. All required data and assignments are valid.
action_or_input: Submit the new club with a category other than Technical, Sports, or Cultural.
expected_result: The club is not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-011 Main Flow (BW-GYM-03, Club Open → Club Confirmed)
purpose: Verify Student Admin approval confirms an open club.
preconditions: A club exists in the Club Open state. A Student Admin is authenticated.
action_or_input: Approve the club.
expected_result: The club transitions to Club Confirmed.

source_id: Problem Statement §3.1 Club Governance; §4.1 In Scope — club activation under Student Admin control
purpose: Verify an actor other than Student Admin cannot confirm a club.
preconditions: A club exists in the Club Open state. A non-Student-Admin actor is authenticated.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the club.
expected_result: The club remains open and is not confirmed.

source_id: Problem Statement §2 Problem Domain; §4.1 In Scope — club leadership changes and current leadership assignment
purpose: Verify a club leadership change updates the current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
preconditions: A club exists. A Club Head is authenticated. The proposed coordinator and co-coordinator are valid students.
action_or_input: Change the club leadership to the proposed students.
expected_result: The club's current leadership assignment reflects the proposed coordinator and co-coordinator.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — coordinator and co-coordinator assignments must refer to valid students
purpose: Verify a leadership change cannot assign an invalid student.
preconditions: A club exists with a current leadership assignment. A Club Head is authenticated. A proposed replacement is not a valid student.
action_or_input: Attempt to change a coordinator or co-coordinator assignment to the invalid student.
expected_result: The invalid assignment is not applied; the current leadership assignment remains unchanged.

source_id: UC-GYM-004 Main Flow (BW-GYM-01, No Membership Application → Membership Application Open)
purpose: Verify a student can apply to a confirmed club.
preconditions: A club is confirmed. A student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to the confirmed club.
expected_result: A membership application is created in the Membership Application Open state.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — membership applications are allowed only for confirmed clubs
purpose: Verify an application cannot be submitted to an unconfirmed club.
preconditions: A club is open but not confirmed. A student has no application to that club.
action_or_input: Attempt to apply for membership in the club.
expected_result: No membership application is created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — duplicate applications to the same club must be prevented
purpose: Verify a student cannot submit a duplicate application to the same club.
preconditions: A club is confirmed. The student already has an open membership application to that club.
action_or_input: Submit another membership application to the same club.
expected_result: No duplicate application is created; the existing application remains open.

source_id: Problem Statement §3.3 Membership Management; §6 Business Constraints — applications to different clubs remain allowed
purpose: Verify a student can apply to multiple different clubs.
preconditions: Two clubs are confirmed. The student has no application to either club.
action_or_input: Submit a membership application to each club.
expected_result: An open membership application exists for each club.

source_id: UC-GYM-005 Main Flow (BW-GYM-01, Membership Application Open → Membership Confirmed)
purpose: Verify the applicable Club Head can approve an open membership application.
preconditions: A membership application is open. The applicable Club Head for that club is authenticated.
action_or_input: Approve the application.
expected_result: The membership transitions to Membership Confirmed.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — only the applicable Club Head may approve pending membership applications
purpose: Verify another club's head cannot approve the application.
preconditions: A membership application is open. A Club Head who is not applicable to that club is authenticated.
action_or_input: Attempt to approve the application.
expected_result: The application remains open and is not confirmed.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 Main Flow (BW-GYM-02, Poll Not Available → Poll Open / Target Audience Defined); Problem Statement §3.6 Student Polling
purpose: Verify a Club Head can create a poll with valid choices and target groups and notify its intended audience.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. Valid target groups are available. The shared notification mechanism is operational.
action_or_input: Create a poll with at least two choices and select valid target groups.
expected_result: The poll is created open with its target audience defined; intended audience members are notified.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 Main Flow (BW-GYM-02, actor is applicable Club Head)
purpose: Verify a non-applicable Club Head cannot create the poll for the club.
preconditions: A Club Head who is not applicable to the club is authenticated. Valid target groups are available.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a poll for that club with at least two choices.
expected_result: The poll is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — a voting poll must contain at least two choices
purpose: Verify poll creation rejects fewer than two choices.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated. Valid target groups are available.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a poll with one choice.
expected_result: The poll is not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-006 Main Flow (BW-GYM-02, valid target groups)
purpose: Verify poll creation rejects invalid target groups.
preconditions: The applicable Club Head is authenticated.
action_or_input: Attempt to create a poll with at least two choices and a target group that is not valid.
expected_result: The poll is not created.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Main Flow (BW-GYM-02, Poll Open / Target Audience Defined / Student Not Yet Voted → Student Vote Recorded)
purpose: Verify an eligible student can record one vote in an active, unexpired poll.
preconditions: A poll is active and unexpired. The student belongs to its target audience and has not voted in it.
action_or_input: Submit a vote in the poll.
expected_result: The student's vote is recorded; the poll remains open and its target audience remains defined.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Main Flow (BW-GYM-02, poll active guard)
purpose: Verify voting is not accepted when the poll is inactive.
preconditions: A poll is inactive. The student belongs to its target audience and has not voted.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a vote.
expected_result: The vote is not recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Main Flow (BW-GYM-02, poll unexpired guard)
purpose: Verify voting is not accepted after a poll expires.
preconditions: A poll has expired. The student belongs to its target audience and has not voted.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a vote.
expected_result: The vote is not recorded.

source_id: UC-GYM-007 Main Flow (BW-GYM-02, student belongs to target audience guard)
purpose: Verify a student outside the target audience cannot vote.
preconditions: A poll is active and unexpired. The student is not in its target audience and has not voted.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a vote.
expected_result: The vote is not recorded.

source_id: Problem Statement §3.6 Student Polling; §6 Business Constraints — at most one vote per student per poll
purpose: Verify a student cannot vote twice in the same poll.
preconditions: A poll is active and unexpired. The student belongs to its target audience and already has a recorded vote.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit another vote in the same poll.
expected_result: No additional vote is recorded; the student's existing vote remains recorded.

source_id: Problem Statement §4.1 In Scope — session booking and notifications for newly booked sessions
purpose: Verify a session can be booked at a configured venue and its notification is delivered.
preconditions: A configured venue is available. The booking time range is valid. The shared notification mechanism is operational.
action_or_input: Book a session at the configured venue on a date and time with no conflicting booking.
expected_result: The session is booked and a notification is delivered to its intended recipients.

source_id: Problem Statement §4.1 In Scope — event booking and notifications for newly booked events
purpose: Verify an event can be booked at a configured venue and its notification is delivered.
preconditions: A configured venue is available. The booking time range is valid. The shared notification mechanism is operational.
action_or_input: Book an event at the configured venue on a date and time with no conflicting booking.
expected_result: The event is booked and a notification is delivered to its intended recipients.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — a booking start time must precede its end time
purpose: Verify a booking with a non-increasing time range is rejected.
preconditions: A configured venue is available and no other booking conflicts.
action_or_input: Attempt to book a session with a start time equal to its end time.
expected_result: The booking is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints; §8 Success Criteria — prevent session-session overlap in the same venue on the same date
purpose: Verify a session cannot overlap another session at the same venue and date.
preconditions: A session already exists at a venue on a date. The proposed session uses the same venue and date and has an overlapping time range.
action_or_input: Attempt to book the proposed session.
expected_result: The new session is not created; the existing session remains unchanged.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints; §8 Success Criteria — prevent event-event overlap in the same venue on the same date
purpose: Verify an event cannot overlap another event at the same venue and date.
preconditions: An event already exists at a venue on a date. The proposed event uses the same venue and date and has an overlapping time range.
action_or_input: Attempt to book the proposed event.
expected_result: The new event is not created; the existing event remains unchanged.

source_id: Problem Statement §3.2 Venue Scheduling; §8 Success Criteria — prevent session-event overlap in the same venue on the same date
purpose: Verify a session cannot overlap an event at the same venue and date.
preconditions: An event already exists at a venue on a date. The proposed session uses the same venue and date and has an overlapping time range.
action_or_input: Attempt to book the proposed session.
expected_result: The new session is not created; the existing event remains unchanged.

source_id: Problem Statement §4.1 In Scope; §6 Business Constraints — club budget-request submission, non-negative amount, and required supporting file
purpose: Verify a club budget request with a non-negative amount and supporting file is retained for tracking.
preconditions: A Club Head is authenticated for the club. File-upload storage is available.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with amount zero and the required supporting file.
expected_result: The request and supporting file are stored and the request can be tracked.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — club budget amounts must be non-negative
purpose: Verify a negative budget amount is rejected.
preconditions: A Club Head is authenticated for the club. File-upload storage is available.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with a negative amount and the required supporting file.
expected_result: The budget request is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — budget requests must include the required supporting file
purpose: Verify a budget request without its required supporting file is rejected.
preconditions: A Club Head is authenticated for the club. File-upload storage is available.
action_or_input: Submit a budget request with a non-negative amount and no supporting file.
expected_result: The budget request is not created.

source_id: Problem Statement §4.1 In Scope; §6 Business Constraints — club event-report submission and required report/details file
purpose: Verify a Club Head can submit an event report with its required file.
preconditions: A Club Head is authenticated for the club. File-upload storage is available.
action_or_input: Submit an event report with the required report/details file.
expected_result: The event report and file are stored in the centralized repository.

source_id: Problem Statement §6 Business Constraints — club event reports must include the required report/details file
purpose: Verify an event report without its required file is rejected.
preconditions: A Club Head is authenticated for the club. File-upload storage is available.
action_or_input: Submit an event report without the required report/details file.
expected_result: The event report is not submitted.

source_id: Problem Statement §3.5 Event Reporting; §8 Success Criteria — assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review reports for the assigned club
purpose: Verify the assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review the club's submitted report.
preconditions: A report has been submitted for a club. A Club Faculty Councillor is assigned to that club.
action_or_input: Access and review the submitted report as the assigned Club Faculty Councillor.
expected_result: The assigned Club Faculty Councillor can access and review the report.
